_comment: Documented licence elections for the MSA 6.6B gate (SB-2204). Every entry states which licence Sensor Bio takes the component under and where that was verified. An election may only land on a licence the policy already allows.

com.sensorbio:sensorbio-sdk.reason: First-party. This is the Sensor Bio Android SDK itself, which this repository publishes; it is not third-party open source and carries no inbound licence obligation. It resolves to no POM on any public repository, which is why the gate reports no licence grant rather than a wrong one.
com.sensorbio:sensorbio-sdk.source: Built from GetSensr-io/mobile_sensorbio_sdk_android, gated in its own right by the licence gate in that repository.
